items.question_open: Which player scored the tenth point for the country whose flag is being waved at the beginning of the video in the first set of the video?
human_observations: A shows female supporters waving an Italian flag.
B shows Italy playing Brazil, with Italian player number 5 scoring.
User confirms B depicts Italy's tenth point in the first set.
B can identify Italy, but cannot determine which country's flag was waved at the beginning; that referent requires A.
Either team could reach ten points, so recognizing Italy in B is not enough to select the target country without A.
evidence_limitations: Semantic referent necessity is user-supported; no model ablation or shortcut-resistance experiment has yet been run.
